policy: The registry records known status/grooming sources. External live values are not ingested unless the provider explicitly authorizes API access. A source link never changes the modeled snow score by itself.

forbush.label: Live grooming source available
forbush.note: Nordic Pulse publishes current grooming reports for Forbush Corner. This site links to that source but does not scrape or redistribute Nordic Pulse data. API ingestion can be enabled only with approved access.

noque.label: Live grooming source available
noque.note: Nordic Pulse publishes current grooming and trackset reports for Forestville and Noque Trail. This site links to that source but does not ingest current values until provider-authorized API access is active.

swedetown.label: Live grooming source available
swedetown.note: Nordic Pulse publishes current grooming and trackset reports for Swedetown Trails. This site links to that source but does not ingest current values until provider-authorized API access is active.
